scope: List marker preservation and authored marker/body anchors; not whole-document visual equivalence.

Native Draw import of the real ODP page using --infilter=draw8, then native Save As ODG; graphics MIME independently verified.

semanticBoundaries: ODP/ODG share the same ODF graphics text adapter. Legacy text:space-before is relative to an authored paragraph margin; the existing list label width remains the fallback body margin.
ODT label-alignment mode stores an absolute margin and explicit suffix/tab position. It is not equivalent to this legacy ODF graphics rule; its adapter remains independent and all 58 ODT tests pass.

RTF preserves the explicit cached listtext/pntext label and uses the shared TextParagraphLayout to anchor its suffix tab. This change does not implement list-table-only label generation or general RTF list numbering.
DOCX legacy inactive num tabs and DrawingML signed bullet indents have separate format semantics. No duplicate equivalent cross-format parser was found in the current worktree or HEAD.
